analyst.summary: Olectra Greentech is India's leading electric-bus maker, riding a genuine, government-backed bus-electrification wave, with revenue growing strongly (if lumpily, on large batch deliveries) and a growing order pipeline. However, returns on capital are still thin, receivables from government transport customers are collected slowly, debt has more than doubled to fund expansion, and there is an ongoing land-related legal dispute tied to a planned new plant. We rate it a Hold: the growth opportunity is real, but the current valuation already assumes a lot of it, while returns on capital have yet to catch up.
